gridDNA: A strong central vertical axis is formed by stacked offer headlines, followed by a fanned, symmetrical arrangement of product bottles. Diagonal sale banners frame the top and bottom of the canvas, creating a dynamic border.

zones.position: top-left to top-right, diagonal, starting 0% from top
zones.treatment: yellow ribbon with repeating text and star icons
zones.note: repeating diagonal banner, partially obscured by product elements behind it

zones.treatment: light blue, sans-serif, uppercase, medium weight
zones.note: first line of the main offer, smaller than subsequent lines

zones.treatment: red, balloon-style 3D text, sans-serif, uppercase, bold
zones.note: visually dominant part of the offer, distinct texture and colour
emphasizes the 'free' aspect, distinct colour from other headlines

zones.treatment: multiple product bottles arranged in a fanned, slightly curved line, with one central hero product slightly larger and forward
zones.note: symmetrical arrangement creating depth, with a clear hero product in the foreground

zones.position: overlaid on hero product, bottom-right of centre, starting 60% from top
zones.treatment: circular yellow badge with dark text, sans-serif, uppercase, bold
zones.note: highlights a specific value proposition for the product bundle, placed on the hero product

zones.position: bottom-left to bottom-right, diagonal, starting 88% from top
zones.treatment: yellow ribbon with repeating text and star icons
zones.note: repeating diagonal banner, mirrors the top banner

zones.treatment: small, dark grey, sans-serif, regular weight
zones.note: legal or offer details in fine print

typeScale: Headline (balloon style) ~15% of canvas height, Headline (blue 'FREE') ~10%, Headline (blue 'BUY 3') ~3%, Banner text ~3%, Badge text ~2%, Disclaimer text ~1%
colourBlocking: Top and bottom diagonal yellow banners frame the white background. The main offer text uses bright red and blue, contrasting sharply with the white. Products are silver with red accents, grounding the bottom half.
negativeSpace: Ample white space surrounds the central offer text and product array, allowing them to stand out without clutter. The space between the main headlines and the products provides breathing room, emphasizing the offer.
eyePath: Top banner -> first offer line -> dominant balloon offer -> emphasized 'FREE' offer -> hero product -> product badge -> surrounding products -> bottom banner -> disclaimer.
whyItWins: The clear, bold, and multi-styled offer text immediately communicates value, while the symmetrical product display reinforces the quantity and desirability of the bundle.
